searchText: Are EthCC recordings available anywhere? <@!301186049323958275> yes, every livestream was immediately available as recording, but due to this stream->save approach, they split it up in one YT channel per stage: St Germain: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCE8CzovkKFj1k8NSxH3HyPg Poissy: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCPL7QtnWHYcjXhvAG_uzf3A Pontoise: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCSiMnvs36TvheBU2rcAM4jA Sorbonne: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCOka-g6iJEpQ9YSIoSn77uQ Monge: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCVgsFxDu5lTqHmpirw5Q69Q Main stage: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC_kOxlaYNOTtNwtwySZ0B8w Is there somewhere that has all of the talks + description in one place, along with information on room/time so one can then dig up the YT link? <@!301186049323958275> https://ethcc.io/agenda Maybe it is just mobile YT not showing me everything, but there appears to be far more talks on the agenda then in the YT channels? Will there ever come a point where ETH no longer needs improvements? (No more EIPs) Aka will there ever be a fully finished product? Let's say someone's using ethereum's smart contract for a charity based fundraiser Is there a way for the donors to track where the funds are going yes, the ik that the transactions are transparent and can be viewed by anyone. But is there possibly a way to not allow funds to be converted into fiat currency? There are a lot of researches on how blockchain can create transparency and trustlessness in fundraising, but what happens if the crypto is converted into fiat? Am i missing something here
